data.tresor:
20 cp, 13 sp, 23 gp, small sapphire (75 gp)
Potions: extraordinary healing (1x, 3d6+3).
Scrolls: locate object (spell check must be made by reader, at a -2 penalty; unsigned, but warded with a protective rune. Any spellcaster can tell that this rune is designed to prevent the scroll from being cast. Anyone attempting to read the scroll must make a DC 16 Will save or forget that the scroll exists), emerikol’s entropic maelstrom (stored in a scroll tube carved from exotic materials and etched with warnings against its use).
